newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mostly lower.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mostly lower on Friday, reflecting a weaker CBOT corn market overnight, but nearby months were up on light technical buying by local investors, traders said.
Prices were 440 yen lower to 60 yen higher, with the benchmark September 1997 contract down 440 yen at 15,690 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 82,240 lots.
Active selling hit the market as investors were discouraged by a weaker CBOT corn market overnight, the traders said.
Distant months, in particular, attracted selling orders, they said.

The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.07-1/4 per bushel at 0710 GMT, against $3.06 at Thursday's close. Spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.94-1/2 at 0710 GMT, against $7.90-3/4 at Thursday's close.
